inlines.v: GOTH, noun One of an ancient and distinguished tribe or nation, which inhabited Scandinavia, now Sweden and Norway, whose language is now retained in those countries, and a large portion of it is found in English. 1. One rude or uncivilized; a barbarian. 2. A rude ignorant person.
